contentOrigin: Open thematic curriculum of 30 units × 20 common English headwords, with original Uzbek translations, IPA pronunciations, and simple original example sentences authored for this starter package.

reading.title: Writing a research paper
reading.content: A good academic paper begins with a clear thesis statement that is specific, arguable, and supported by evidence. The methodology section must explain how data was collected and analyzed so that other researchers can replicate the study. In the discussion, authors should acknowledge limitations and avoid overstating conclusions. Peer review is essential before publication.
reading.translationUz: Yaxshi akademik maqola aniq, bahsli va dalillar bilan tasdiqlangan tezis bayonotidan boshlanadi. Metodologiya qismi ma’lumotlarning qanday to‘planganini va tahlil qilinganini tushuntirishi kerak, shunda boshqa tadqiqotchilar tajribani takrorlay oladi. Munozarada mualliflar cheklovlarni tan olishi va xulosalarni oshirib yubormasligi lozim. Nashrdan oldin ekspert ko‘rigidan o‘tish zarur.

reading.title: Reading a scientific abstract
reading.content: A well-written abstract is a miniature version of the paper. It states the research question, the method used to investigate it, the main findings, and the implications of those findings. A reader scanning dozens of abstracts should be able to decide, in under a minute, whether the full paper is relevant to their work. Vague language or hidden assumptions make this impossible.
reading.translationUz: Yaxshi yozilgan abstract — maqolaning mo‘ljaldagi kichik versiyasi. U tadqiqot savolini, uni o‘rganish uchun qo‘llanilgan metodni, asosiy natijalarni va bu natijalarning oqibatlarini bayon qiladi. O‘nlab abstractlarni ko‘zdan kechirayotgan o‘quvchi bir daqiqadan kam vaqt ichida to‘liq maqola o‘z ishiga tegishli yoki yo‘qligini aniqlay olishi kerak. Noaniq til yoki yashirin taxminlar buni imkonsiz qiladi.

questions.question: A reader scanning abstracts needs to decide:

reading.title: Peer review
reading.content: Peer review is the main quality filter in academic publishing. Reviewers, usually experts in the same field as the author, evaluate the paper's originality, methodology, and clarity. The system is slow and imperfect — reviewers may be biased or overlook errors — but it remains the best mechanism we have for separating credible science from noise.
reading.translationUz: Ekspert ko‘rigi — akademik nashriyotda sifat uchun asosiy filtr. Taqrizchilar, odatda muallif bilan bir sohadagi mutaxassislar, maqolaning yangiligi, metodologiyasi va aniqligini baholaydi. Tizim sekin va mukammal emas — taqrizchilar noxolis bo‘lishi yoki xatolarni e'tibordan chetda qoldirishi mumkin — lekin bu ishonchli ilmdan shovqinni ajratish uchun bizda bor eng yaxshi mexanizm.

reading.title: The scientific hypothesis
reading.content: A good scientific hypothesis must be falsifiable: there must exist some observable outcome that, if seen, would disprove it. Statements that explain any possible result are not scientific — they are not wrong, but they do not advance understanding. Testing and attempting to falsify hypotheses is the engine of empirical progress.
reading.translationUz: Yaxshi ilmiy gipoteza inkor qilinishi mumkin bo‘lishi kerak: agar ko‘rilsa, uni rad etadigan biror kuzatiladigan natija bo‘lishi kerak. Har qanday natijani tushuntiradigan bayonotlar ilmiy emas — ular noto‘g‘ri emas, lekin tushunchani oshirmaydi. Gipotezalarni sinab ko‘rish va rad etishga urinish — empirik taraqqiyot dvigateli.

reading.title: Legal interpretation
reading.content: Judges often face the challenge of applying old statutes to situations their drafters never imagined. One school of thought — originalism — argues that the meaning of the text at the time of writing should govern. Another — purposivism — holds that courts should give effect to the law's underlying purpose, even if that means stretching the words. Modern practice blends both.
reading.translationUz: Sudyalar ko‘pincha eski qonunlarni ularning tuzuvchilari hech qachon tasavvur qilmagan vaziyatlarga qo‘llash qiyinchiligiga duch keladi. Bir maktab — originalizm — matnning yozilgan paytdagi ma'nosi hukmron bo‘lishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Boshqasi — purposivizm — sudlar qonunning asosiy maqsadini amalga oshirishi kerak, hatto bu so‘zlarni cho‘zishni anglatsa ham, deb biladi. Zamonaviy amaliyot ikkalasini birlashtiradi.

options: Meaning at the time of writing
